# Curate taskgraph snapshots instead of copying a personal release artifact unchanged

The fixture updater replaces owner with user@example.com, clears release_history unless a -partials fixture asks to retain it, and walks past on-push parameters whose target method is nothing or whose dontbuild is true. Preserve these transformations when refreshing fixtures. Generated parameter YAML is excluded from yamllint. The bulk output at entry 624 is excluded from this human-code study; the updater and parameter test were inspected.

Scope: taskcluster/test/params.
